purpose: Make the July 13-August 12 Commercial Rent Stabilization record more legible without converting plans, requests, staff work, report review, descriptive association, or source access into stronger unsupported claims.

criteria.name: Prepared and delivered remarks stay distinct
criteria.passCondition: The delivered-speech claim requires the event recording, and the prepared statement cannot be substituted for it.

criteria.name: Run of show is not attendance
criteria.passCondition: A planning roster cannot establish that a listed official attended or spoke.

criteria.name: Staff coordination is not elected-official endorsement
criteria.passCondition: Recent city and state evidence is described as legislative-staff work unless a separate source establishes direct elected-official interaction.

criteria.name: Scheduled is not completed
criteria.passCondition: The accepted August 26 meeting remains future scheduling until an occurrence record exists.

criteria.name: Press request is not coverage
criteria.passCondition: The NBC footage request cannot become a broadcast, interview, quotation, article, or Jamie-attributed coverage claim.

criteria.name: Review credit stays bounded
criteria.passCondition: The final acknowledgment supports thoughtful and careful review, not report authorship, data analysis, whole-report validation, or organizational endorsement.

criteria.name: Association is not motive or causation
criteria.passCondition: District-level rent and vacancy association cannot establish landlord motive, warehousing, financing behavior, or individual closure cause.

criteria.name: Public event is not media permission
criteria.passCondition: Audio, images, footage, exact quotations, and informal remarks remain held for rights and consent review.

criteria.name: Public projection remains a human gate
criteria.passCondition: Every new website and resume projection is held or disallowed until Jamie approval and its source and rights gates close.

criteria.name: Social publication is not coalition credit
criteria.passCondition: A live campaign post remains distinct from accepted collaboration, completed NYC Artist Coalition credit, Jamie authorship, Jamie-attributed coverage, and image-reuse permission.

command: npm run evals:commercial-rent-advocacy && npm run test:commercial-rent-advocacy
humanGates: Jamie approves any promotion into the portfolio or resume.
The report owner approves attribution beyond the printed acknowledgment.
The delivered transcript is checked against audio before exact quotation.
Recording and image rights are reviewed separately from factual event verification.
Future meetings are recorded only after occurrence and participant review.
